This project aims to assess the energy fluxes from primary producers to planktivorous fish.

The project was presented as a talk at the Ocean Science Meeting 2026, February 2026, Glasgow, UK, and during the [Baltic Sea Breakfast](https://www.su.se/english/divisions/stockholm-university-baltic-sea-centre/news/articles/2026-05-26-baltic-breakfast-new-dna-methods-reveal-surprising-role-of-cyanobacteria-in-baltic-food-webs){.button taget=_blank} in May 2026.


Work in progress...
